# Chronicle

Chat and the game log.

`LL.Chronicle` · Shell

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Chronicle channels={…} messages={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Chronicle" channels="{{…}}" messages="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
